paite: Huan Moab Phaizang a pan Jeriko zawn a Nebo tang, Pisgah tang vum ah Mosi ahohtou a; TOUPA'N Gilead gam tengteng, Dan pha in a-ensak hi.
heading: Mosi Sihna

paite: Naphtali leh Ephraim gam tengteng, Manasseh leh Judia gam tengteng, atumlam tuipi pha in.
Sim gam leh tum khopi Jeriko Phaizang, Zoar pha in.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hiai gam ahi Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, 'Na suante ka pe ding,' chi a kichiam a ka na chiam. Muh ahihleh ka hon musak peuhmah a, himahleh huai ah na pai kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi, TOUPA thu bang in Moab gam ah asita hi.
heading: Mosi Sihna Leh Vuina

paite: Beth-peor zawn a Moab gam phaizang ah avui a; himahleh tuni tan in kuamah in ahan athei kei uh.
Mosi asih in kum za-le-sawmnih a upa ahi; amit amial kei a, atha leng akiam tuan kei hi.
Israel suante'n Moab Phaizang ah ni sawmthum Mosi akah ua, huchi in Mosi suun a, akah nite uh hong beita hi.
Mosi in atung a, akhut akoih ziak in Nun tapa Joshua pilna kha in adim a; Israel suante'n athu azui ua, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
Huai nung in Israelte lak ah Mosi bang a TOUPA'N kimaituah a ahoupih zawlnei himhim a-omta kei;
heading: Mosi Thilhihte

paite: chiamtehna leh thillamdang tengteng, Pharaoh leh asikha tengteng kiang leh Aigupta gam tengteng a-ensak a,
khut hattak leh lauhuai pipi a Israel mi teng mitmuh a Mosi in ahih bang hih a-om kei uhi.
